readings: Group tracks by AlbumId, with all tracks that have no album id forming one group. For each group, show the album id, the average track UnitPrice, and the group's rate, which is the average of each track's Bytes divided by Milliseconds. Also show the signed difference: the group's rate minus the average of the per-group rates across all groups, including the no-album group. Ignore missing values in averages and don't round. List the 10 groups with the largest signed difference (rate minus overall average), largest first, so the groups furthest above the average come first.

Group tracks by AlbumId, with all tracks that have no album id forming one group. For each group, show the album id, the average track UnitPrice, and the group's rate, which is the average of each track's Bytes divided by Milliseconds. Also show the absolute difference: the absolute value of the group's rate minus the average of the per-group rates across all groups, including the no-album group. Ignore missing values in averages and don't round. List the 10 groups with the largest absolute difference, largest first. This counts groups far below the average as well as those far above it.
queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT AlbumId,
         AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price,
         AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS rate
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
)
SELECT AlbumId,
       avg_price,
       rate,
       rate - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM g) AS diff
FROM g
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH g AS (
  SELECT AlbumId,
         AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
         AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS rate
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
)
SELECT AlbumId,
       avg_unit_price,
       rate,
       ABS(rate - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM g)) AS abs_diff
FROM g
WHERE rate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY abs_diff DESC
LIMIT 10
